name: Cup
summary: The cup and saucer are a Chinese copy of a later German reproduction of an early Meissen ware. The mark "AR" (Augustus Rex), which was used on Meissen porcelain between 1723 and 1736, was then copied by Meissen decorators imitating earlier styles during the second half of the 19th century.
